title: Visiting Professor of Law
bio: Michele DeStefano is an educator, author, professional speaker, and global program leader who works with senior professional service providers to advance leadership, innovation, and—most importantly—collaboration in the legal profession. As a professor at the University of Miami and a visiting professor at Harvard Law School, Michele teaches in university and executive education settings and has […]
